en.pit.departure.alias_alive: Alias thanks the party and leaves. The scent of honeysuckle fills the air as Dragonbait bows and follows her.
en.pit.departure.alias_dead: Dragonbait carries Alias's body toward Hillsfar.
en.zhentil.patrol_pass: A Zhentil Keep patrol notices the sigils on the party's arms and lets them pass.
en.zhentil.edge: You are at the edge of Zhentil Keep. Will you enter or continue your journey?
en.zhentil.guards_question: The guards take the party aside for questioning and record Journal Entry 32.
en.zhentil.guards_warning: A guard says the party matches the little thief's description; the commander says they will get theirs inside.
en.zhentil.inner_city: You join the teeming masses of the inner city.
en.journal.32: Journal Entry 32: Two guards and their commander compile a detailed file on the party and insist that it is strictly routine.
en.zhentil.olive_appears: A female halfling appears from a hidden niche. You enter her statement as Journal Entry 50.
en.zhentil.dark_shrine_entry: You enter the Dark Shrine through a hole in the wall made by the halfling's magical device. The walls close behind you as the device smokes and disappears.
en.zhentil.olive_explains: As Olive leads you through the dungeon, she explains about Dimswart the Sage. You record Journal Entry 51.
en.zhentil.dimswart_door: Dimswart is just beyond this door.
en.journal.50.1: Journal Entry 50 (1/2): Olive says, “Well now, aren't we a fine bunch of adventurers. My name is Olive Ruskettle, and I know a bit about those tattoos on your arms. A friend of mine had similar marks a while back. I wonder where she is...”
en.journal.50.2: Journal Entry 50 (2/2): “Listen, you must get hold of the Amulet of Lathander. A man who can help you has been captured inside the temple. His name is Dimswart the Sage, and he helped that friend I mentioned. I know a secret way into the temple. What do you say?”
en.journal.51.1: Journal Entry 51 (1/2): “The human you seek is Dimswart. He is a very good sage and a music lover, which is why we get along. Did you know I was a bard? Yes sir, my harp is right here and I could sing for you—well, perhaps now is not the time.”
en.journal.51.2: Journal Entry 51 (2/2): “Anyway, Fzoul Chembryl captured Dimswart to learn about the other bonds. I can get you to his cell, but I need your help to free him. I'll slip out my own way; I cannot let any Banite priests see me. Only someone as slippery as I am can squeeze through the route I know.”
en.zhentil.olive_cell_hint: Olive suddenly appears and says that the man she mentioned is in the cell to the south.
en.zhentil.olive_repeats_dimswart: As Olive explains about Dimswart, you record her remarks as Journal Entry 51.
en.zhentil.dimswart_appears: An old man is in the cell. He introduces himself, and you record his remarks as Journal Entry 12.
en.journal.12.1: Journal Entry 12 (1/6): Dimswart says, “My name is Dimswart the Sage. I am happy to meet you, though I wish it were under better circumstances. I knew others with bonds like yours and have studied them. Some symbols are now missing, but originally there must have been five—the power signs of five mighty factions joined together.”
en.journal.12.2: Journal Entry 12 (2/6): “Needless to say, all five are extremely evil. Their common purpose is to increase their collective power. Yet if this bonding follows the previous pattern—and with Moander and the Fire Knives involved I have little doubt—each evil power has its own use for you, at the others' expense. That is your greatest advantage.”
en.journal.12.3: Journal Entry 12 (3/6): “I know one bond personally. The hand with a mouth is Moander's symbol. His aspect was destroyed the last time he tried to enter this plane. Mogion, his surviving High Priestess, probably placed it upon you as part of her attempt to bring him back.”
en.journal.12.4: Journal Entry 12 (4/6): “The ornate Z inside a circle on a triangular field is the Zhentrim's mark—our hosts, I fear. They are said to hide a great hoard of lawful-good weapons and magic. I learned it is not in Zhentil Keep. Fzoul Chembryl seeks to place good people under his power so he can use these devices.”
en.journal.12.5: Journal Entry 12 (5/6): “The half moon crossed by three bars belongs to Dracandros, a powerful but banished Red Wizard of Thay obsessed with dragons. The flaming claws belong to Tyranthraxus. He is the greatest threat: he seeks dominion over the entire Prime Material Plane and controls the Pool of Radiance.”
en.journal.12.6: Journal Entry 12 (6/6): “To finish Tyranthraxus you need three artifacts divided among the powers that bonded you: the Amulet of Lathander here in Zhentil Keep, Dracandros's Helm of Dragons near Haptooth, and Mogion's Gauntlet of Moander at Yulash. I cannot offer much fighting power, but I know how to stay out of the way.”
en.zhentil.hooded_offer: A hooded woman suddenly appears. “Follow me. I can get you out of here! You are trapped here! My master can help you.”
en.zhentil.fzoul_interrupts: A strange shimmer surrounds you and the room begins to fade. A band of clerics bursts in, led by Fzoul Chembryl. He shouts, “Woman, you go too far!”
en.zhentil.fzoul_retreats: As the room fades away, Fzoul turns and rushes out.
en.dexam.arrival: You are led along a dark corridor and see Dexam the beholder. The hooded woman walks toward a milling group of armored minotaurs; they immediately snap to attention.
en.dexam.journal_30: Dexam speaks. You record his speech as Journal Entry 30.
en.dexam.amulet_choice: Dimswart the Sage whispers, “Look on the altar. That is the Amulet of Lathander.” What do you do?
en.dexam.fzoul_journal_7: Before you can act, an impressive man backed by troops, priests and mages rushes in. His statement is recorded as Journal Entry 7.
en.dexam.kills_fzoul: Dexam roars, “Then die, heretic!” and blasts Fzoul into a heap of ash. The bonds on your arms begin to writhe.
en.dexam.kill_order: “Now that the bond is gone, they are of no use to me. Kill them.”
en.dexam.amulet_rises: Dexam turns toward the altar and starts to leave. You notice the amulet rising to meet him.
en.dexam.altar_melee: As Dexam leaves, his forces and Fzoul's remaining troops begin to melee around you.
en.dexam.final_reveal: You have caught up with Dexam and his minions. The hooded woman casts off her disguise—she is a medusa!
en.dexam.amulet_retrieved: You retrieve the Amulet of Lathander from Dexam's mangled remains.
en.dexam.zhentil_attack: Forces of Zhentil Keep attack you!
en.dexam.departure.olive: Olive Ruskettle appears just outside the door. She says, “So, you made it. I'm surprised.”
en.dexam.departure.dimswart: “Dimswart, you come with me. A man from Shadowdale has some questions for you.” Olive and Dimswart leave.
en.dexam.departure.gharri: You see a rider in the distance. He stops suddenly, and a moment later you hear something like “Gharriiii” drifting through the air.
en.dexam.departure.riders: The rider changes direction and gallops to a woman dressed in purple. They embrace; she climbs onto the horse, and they ride away.
en.world.shadowdale.edge: You are at the edge of Shadowdale. Will you enter or continue your journey?
en.journal.30.1: Journal Entry 30 (1/2): Dexam says, “So, these are Fzoul's little secret. Very interesting. As the representative of the TRUE priests of Bane, I shall deliver you to Mulmaster and the grand Imperceptor.”
en.journal.30.2: Journal Entry 30 (2/2): “In Mulmaster I will examine these bonds in my laboratory—to your extreme discomfort. During the final procedure, the one resulting in your death, the pain should last no more than two or perhaps three weeks. Once I uncover their secret, the Imperceptor will be most angry with dear little Fzoul, and we may finally be rid of this heretic and his precious mages.”
en.journal.7.1: Journal Entry 7 (1/2): “I am Fzoul Chembryl, high lord of the Dark Shrine. My precious mages, as you call them, allowed me to follow your minion. Dexam, you overstep your authority. My mark is on these people, and the Imperceptor will know of my work in due time.”
en.journal.7.2: Journal Entry 7 (2/2): “I work for the greater glory of Bane. The powers Bane granted us, joined with secular magic-users, will establish a Banite hegemony in the Realms. These bonded tools are central to our power and will let me control and evade the traps of lawful and good magic. They are under my authority and shall remain so for as long as I live.”
en.myth-drannor.tyranthraxus-reveal: The bonds reveal Tyranthraxus. He commands you to meet him at Myth Drannor.
en.myth-drannor.edge: You are at the edge of Myth Drannor. Will you enter or continue your journey?
en.myth-drannor.helm-north: The Helm of Dragons reports that Tyranthraxus is to the north.
en.myth-drannor.elf-spirit.greeting: An elfish spirit appears and greets you. What do you do?
en.myth-drannor.elf-spirit.journal-25: The spirit tells you about the glen. You record Journal Entry 25, and then the spirit fades.
en.myth-drannor.elf-spirit.flee: “So, you are sheep! Then you shall feed me.” The spirit fades.
en.myth-drannor.red-web: A red web stretches across the passage, glowing dully.
en.myth-drannor.red-web.hack: As you strike, the glow fades from the webs, revealing several wire snares as well. In the distance you hear cursing, then running feet.
en.myth-drannor.red-web.rakshasa: The spirit appears laughing. It fades, revealing a rakshasa.
en.myth-drannor.grave.thri-kreen: A thri-kreen is excavating a grave. At your approach it turns and attacks.
en.myth-drannor.grave.skeleton: You see a partially excavated elf skeleton. Jewelry glitters on its wrist. What will you do?
en.myth-drannor.daemir.offer: A spirit appears before you. “I am the spirit of Princess Daemir. You seem good people. Will you accept my blessing?”
en.myth-drannor.daemir.forgiveness-offer: A spirit appears before you. “I am the spirit of Princess Daemir. You have despoiled the glen—perhaps from ignorance. If you kneel now, you may accept my forgiveness.”
en.myth-drannor.daemir.blessing: “Go forth with my blessing.” She fades away.
en.myth-drannor.daemir.curse: “You presume too much! As long as you are in Myth Drannor, your weapons will twist in your hands.” She fades away.
en.myth-drannor.phase-spider-wall: As you enter, spiders come out of the solid walls.
en.myth-drannor.phase-spider-glowing: Glowing spiders skitter forward at your approach.
en.myth-drannor.phase-spider-bones: Spiders have gathered a pile of bones here and defend it.
en.myth-drannor.bones.prompt: What do you do with the bones?
en.myth-drannor.thri-kreen.entrance: A party of thri-kreen bars your entrance.
en.myth-drannor.thri-kreen.bivouac: The thri-kreen have bivouacked here. They prepare to make a stand.
en.myth-drannor.thri-kreen.reinforcements: Other thri-kreen respond to the noise.
en.myth-drannor.spider-mausoleum: Webs festoon this mausoleum. The webs are inhabited.
en.myth-drannor.spider-funnel: You see a funnel of webs.
en.myth-drannor.spider-warning: A whispery voice calls out, “The spiders will guard their nest fiercely.” Do you continue?
en.myth-drannor.spider-eggs: Spiders leap forth. You can see some eggs behind them.
en.myth-drannor.court.entry: Near the building entrance lies a crushed thri-kreen. A ghostly shape stands in the doorway.
en.myth-drannor.court.enter: Do you want to enter the building?
en.myth-drannor.court.welcome: The spirit says, “Welcome, warriors. Enter and meet our Queen.”
en.myth-drannor.court.armor: Two suits of armor flank this stairway, radiating faint magic. One says, “The Queen will see you.”
en.myth-drannor.court.armor-bows: The armor seems to bow as you pass.
en.myth-drannor.court.armor-crumbles: The armor crumbles into rusty flakes.
en.myth-drannor.court.greeting: As you approach the stairs, a voice calls, “The court gives greetings.”
en.myth-drannor.court.hostile: As you approach the stairs, a voice calls, “Despoilers shall fight despoilers.”
en.myth-drannor.court.reward: A spirit appears. “My heart rejoices to have such defenders. These items may help your quest.”
en.myth-drannor.court.farewell: “Alas, my time is short here. My best wishes to you.” She disappears.
en.myth-drannor.court.hostile-offer: A spirit appears. “This glen has been crushed by your kind. If you leave, you may have the remnants of our treasure. Will you?”
en.myth-drannor.court.refusal: “Then lie with us!” The tower begins to collapse around you. You rush outside.
en.myth-drannor.court.collapse: The tower falls into a pile of rubble.
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.gesture: A Red Plume makes a gesture of friendship.
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.journal: The Red Plume tells you his tale. You record Journal Entry 33. What will you do?
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.warning: “Follow me.” A whispery voice cries, “Beware—a trap!” The Red Plume snarls and silences the voice with a gesture.
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.refusal: “Then I shall try myself.” He goes through the gate. Suddenly, a scream pierces the air. Will you investigate?
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.spiders: Within an unearthed grave, glowing spiders swarm out to protect their eggs.
en.myth-drannor.red-plume.reveal: Within an unearthed grave, glowing spiders swarm out to protect their eggs. The Red Plume steps away and fires at you—his shape changes.
en.myth-drannor.clan-figure.greeting: A figure appears from the shadows. “Hail, bonded ones!”
en.myth-drannor.clan-figure.journal: The figure launches into rapid speech. You record Journal Entry 56. “Hurry on, hurry, hurry!” He leaves.
en.myth-drannor.more-ruins: You are heading toward more ruins. Will you travel by a path or through the woods?
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.greeting: A rakshasa with matted fur and a dour expression comes around the corner and makes a gesture of peace. What do you do?
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.tale: The rakshasa says, “I am Tirsheya.” He tells his tale, which you record as Journal Entry 5. Will you go with him?
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.guards: “Then come with me.” The entrance is guarded. Do you attack?
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.beyrha-arriv: The battle draws another rakshasa and his retinue. He accuses Tirsheya of robbing the clan.
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.ultimatum: Beyrha says, “Humans, bring me Tirsheya's head and you will be forgiven; otherwise you will be tonight's main dish.” Whom do you attack?
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.attack-beyrh: “You are fools, but we will thank you at dinner.”
en.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.name: Tirsheya
en.myth-drannor.outer.beyrha.name: Beyrha
en.myth-drannor.outer.storehouse.guards: Some margoyles and hell hounds guard the entrance to this building. They prepare for combat. Do you flee?
en.myth-drannor.outer.storehouse.supplies: Piled within this building is a large array of foodstuffs, clothing, and trinkets.
en.myth-drannor.outer.storehouse.valuables: Piled within this building is a large array of foodstuffs, clothing, and trinkets. Eventually, you find a few valuables.
en.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.intro: Ahead, you see a man running near exhaustion, chased by a pack of hell hounds. He stumbles and collapses. Do you go to the rescue?
en.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.killed: The hounds leap upon the man and tear him to shreds. They soon finish their work. Do you attack?
en.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.clue: The man thanks you and whispers, “I hid it before I was captured…a ruined building…northeast. Your reward.” His breathing stops.
en.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.remains: The hounds left little that can be recognized as human. You find nothing of value.
en.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.cache: Just as the dying man described, you locate a hidden cache.
en.myth-drannor.outer.nameless-warning: Nameless slides out of the shadows and says, “This direct approach is dangerous, but the temple is to the north. Now get on with it!” Then he leaves.
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-decoy: Dense brush fills the plaza ahead. A small child—or perhaps a halfling—runs over and dives into it as a hell hound tries to leap in after him. Do you go to the rescue?
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-rescue: You arrive before the hell hound can force its way into the brush and cut it down.
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-ambush: A rakshasa stands up from the brush and says, “Why, thank you. Such kindness should be rewarded.” At his gesture, margoyles on the nearby roofs pelt you with rocks.
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-attack: The monsters then leap down to attack.
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-victim: After a moment, the hell hound emerges from the brush with something bloody in its mouth and trots off.
en.myth-drannor.outer.brush-bloodstains: The brush is dense and filled with rubble. A few bloodstains mark the leaves.
en.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-trap: Two margoyles are torturing a small animal in a doorway just ahead. They are unaware of you. Do you attack?
en.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-collapse: You swiftly kill them. Laughter sounds behind you, and the doorway collapses onto the party.
en.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-rakshasa: A rakshasa approaches while you are buried. Do you play dead?
en.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-surprise: You surprise him as he reaches for you.
en.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-retreat: Seeing that the collapse failed to finish you, he turns and disappears.
en.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-margoyle: A lone margoyle skitters away, uncovering a sewer grate. It seems to be trying to flee. Do you let it?
en.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-escape: It runs down through the sewer and disappears.
en.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-kill: You slaughter it where it stands.
en.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-grate: There is a sewer grate here. Do you want to enter?
en.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-warning: A dreamlike voice in your head warns, “Great danger lies before you. Be fully prepared!” Do you still continue?
en.myth-drannor.kitchen-arrival: The sewer ends in a darkened kitchen. A rumble and cloud of dust force you from the tunnel.
en.myth-drannor.outer.gambling-room: In this opulent room, male rakshasas gamble with dice while females lounge on pillows and margoyles watch intently.
en.myth-drannor.outer.gambling-rise: They finally notice you and slowly rise. Do you flee?
en.myth-drannor.inner.bedroom: You enter an elegant bedroom with a four-poster bed, tapestries, and gold fixtures. Do you want to loot the room?
en.myth-drannor.inner.office: This room has been converted to an office. The walls are covered with icons of Bane.
en.myth-drannor.inner.kitchen: You enter the kitchen. Slaves dive under the tables at your arrival; they are no threat to you.
en.myth-drannor.outer.rakshasa-residence: A rakshasa resides here in splendor.
en.myth-drannor.outer.rakshasa-threat: The rakshasa stands as several more appear. “To disturb one of my rank invites death. Prepare for yours.”
en.myth-drannor.outer.rakshasa-parlay: The rakshasa smiles. “Your boldness is refreshing.” He tells his story, which you record as Journal Entry 57.
en.journal.25: Journal Entry 25: We spirits of Myth Drannor have grown weak over the centuries and can now do little but observe. We ask for your help. In return, here is a secret power of the thri-kreen: within this building is a glowing red web. Speak the word Krrkik while standing before it, then walk into it, and you will gain great strength. I have seen many thri-kreen do this.
en.journal.33: Journal Entry 33: “I am Caemir, and my ancestors lived and died here in Myth Drannor. Evil dreams have shown my grandfather's tomb turned into a nest for foul spider creatures. Help me lay his spirit to rest, and I will give you the bow he made.” He shows you an exquisitely crafted bow radiating powerful magic.
en.journal.56: Journal Entry 56: The man refuses to give his name, saying that names are labels for things people do not understand. He knows of the bonds and the party's struggle because he helped create the first bonds long ago. The final bond, Tyranthraxus's, is the most dangerous: Tyranthraxus no longer shares control and can devote his full fury to preventing escape. The party must surprise and defeat him before he invokes the bonds. The man's clan is resting here for several mortal lifetimes, but Tyranthraxus stole their followers and threatened them. They hate him yet cannot attack his temple directly. When the party attacks, the clan will reclaim its followers, perhaps weakening Tyranthraxus enough for victory.
en.journal.57: Journal Entry 57: “It is good to speak with those with confidence enough to deal. My clan has taken this spot as a place to rest for a few mortal lifetimes. But Tyranthraxus, the Flamed One, has stolen our followers and threatened my clan. His power is such that we cannot attack his temple directly, though we hate him with great passion. Now to our deal. You wear the Flamed One's mark, but I have been told you are his enemy. When you attack his temple we will bend our power to reclaim our followers. That may weaken him enough for you to be victorious.”
en.journal.5: Journal Entry 5: “We rakshasas are very fond of gambling. I suffered a streak of bad luck and lost most of my possessions. Recently I discovered that Birsheya had been cheating, but the clan lord will not act without proof. Birsheya guards the clan storehouse, and I know evidence is hidden there. Help me break in and you may choose whatever you want from the storehouse; I want only proof of Birsheya's cheating.”

zh-TW.pit.departure.alias_alive: 愛麗雅絲說：「我們必須在此分別了。」她感謝你們一路相助，祝眾人好運後轉身離去。空氣中瀰漫著忍冬花香；龍餌靜靜看過每一位夥伴，鞠躬致意，隨後跟上愛麗雅絲。
zh-TW.pit.departure.alias_dead: 龍餌抱起愛麗雅絲的遺體，向眾人沉默地鞠躬，隨後朝希爾斯法的方向離去。
zh-TW.zhentil.patrol_pass: 一隊散提爾堡巡邏兵攔住你們。他們注意到眾人手臂上的枷印後，隨即放行。
zh-TW.zhentil.edge: 你們來到散提爾堡城外。要進城，還是繼續旅程？
zh-TW.zhentil.guards_question: 「站住！到這裡來！我們有些問題要問你們！」衛兵把隊伍帶到一旁盤問；你們將此事記入冒險手札第 32 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.guards_warning: 離開時，你們聽見一名衛兵說：「果然和那個小賊說的一樣。」指揮官回答：「別擔心，他們進城後自然會吃到苦頭。」
zh-TW.zhentil.inner_city: 你們匯入熙來攘往的人群，進入散提爾堡內城。
zh-TW.journal.32: 手札條目 32：兩名衛兵與指揮官盤問你們。每回答一次「是」，其中一名衛兵便冷笑著記入冊中；每回答一次「否」，另一名衛兵便哼聲記在不同的簿冊。指揮官詳細抄下全隊的姓名、來歷與各項資料。每當有人追問盤查的理由，三人便一同冷笑；指揮官只說：「我們正在建立你們的檔案，這只是例行公事。」
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_appears: 一名半身人女子從隱密壁龕中現身。你們將她的話記入冒險手札第 50 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.dark_shrine_entry: 半身人帶著的魔法裝置在牆上開出洞口，你們就此穿牆進入幽暗神殿。身後牆壁重新閉合；裝置冒出白煙，隨即消失無蹤。
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_explains: 奧莉芙領著你們穿過地牢，一路說明賢者迪姆斯沃特的遭遇。你們將此事記入冒險手札第 51 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.dimswart_door: 迪姆斯沃特就在這扇門的另一頭。
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_leaves: 奧莉芙微微一笑，轉眼便消失了。
zh-TW.journal.50.1: 手札條目 50（1/2）：奧莉芙說：「唷，這可真是一群了不起的冒險者。我叫奧莉芙・魯斯克特爾；你們手臂上的刺青，我倒知道一點。前陣子我有個朋友也帶著相似的印記。不曉得她如今人在何方……」
zh-TW.journal.50.2: 手札條目 50（2/2）：「聽著，你們一定得拿到洛山達護符。有個人能幫忙，可是他被抓進神殿囚禁了。他叫賢者迪姆斯沃特，也曾幫過我剛才提到的那位朋友。我知道一條進神殿的密道。你們意下如何？」
zh-TW.journal.51.1: 手札條目 51（1/2）：「你們要找的人類名叫迪姆斯沃特。他是位非常出色的賢者，而且熱愛音樂，所以我們才這麼投緣。你們知道我是吟遊詩人嗎？真的，我的豎琴就在身邊，本來還能唱一曲給你們聽——唔，現在或許不是時候。」
zh-TW.journal.51.2: 手札條目 51（2/2）：「總之，弗佐爾・錢布瑞爾抓走迪姆斯沃特，是為了逼問其他枷印的事。我能帶你們到牢房，但救他出來得靠你們。我會用自己的辦法溜走，絕不能讓貝恩祭司看見我。那條路狹窄得很，只有像我這般滑溜的人才鑽得過去。」
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_cell_hint: 奧莉芙忽然出現在你們面前。「總算來了。我提過的那個人，就關在南邊的牢房裡。」
zh-TW.zhentil.olive_repeats_dimswart: 奧莉芙說明迪姆斯沃特的遭遇；你們將她的話記入冒險手札第 51 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.dimswart_appears: 牢房裡有一位老人。他自我介紹後，你們將他的話記入冒險手札第 12 條。
zh-TW.zhentil.dimswart_join: 要讓迪姆斯沃特同行嗎？
zh-TW.journal.12.1: 手札條目 12（1/6）：迪姆斯沃特說：「我叫賢者迪姆斯沃特。很高興認識諸位，只可惜相逢的情勢不太理想。我曾遇過帶著相似枷印的人，也花了一段時間研究。你們身上有些符號已經消失，但原本應有五個——那是五個強大勢力聯手留下的力量印記。」
zh-TW.journal.12.2: 手札條目 12（2/6）：「不消說，這五方全都邪惡至極；他們結盟，是為了擴張共同的力量。然而，若這批枷印仍遵循過去的模式——既然牽涉摩安德與火焰匕首，我幾乎可以肯定——每一方都想利用你們達成自己的目的，甚至不惜損害其他盟友。這正是你們最大的優勢。」
zh-TW.journal.12.3: 手札條目 12（3/6）：「其中一道枷印，我有親身了解。掌心生口的手掌是摩安德的標誌。祂上次企圖進入這個位面時，化身已遭摧毀。如今很可能是祂倖存的大祭司摩貢把印記放在你們身上，作為讓摩安德重返世間的計畫之一。」
zh-TW.journal.12.4: 手札條目 12（4/6）：「三角形底紋、圓圈裡的華麗 Z 字，代表散塔林會——也就是我們眼下的『東道主』。據說他們藏有大批守序善良陣營的武器與魔法物品。我被捕前正追查此事，已確定寶藏不在散塔林堡。傳聞首領弗佐爾・錢布瑞爾企圖控制善良之人，好讓自己能夠運用那些寶物。」
zh-TW.journal.12.5: 手札條目 12（5/6）：「三道橫槓穿過半月，是德拉坎德羅斯的標誌。他是力量強大的塞爾紅袍法師，卻因野心過盛又不懂時機與手腕而遭放逐，並且對龍異常著迷。燃燒的利爪則屬於烈焰之主提朗瑟克斯；他的威脅最大，野心是支配整個主物質位面，而且掌握著光芒之池。」
zh-TW.journal.12.6: 手札條目 12（6/6）：「要徹底消滅提朗瑟克斯，你們需要三件分散在枷印勢力手中的神器：散塔林堡某處的洛山達護符、哈普附近德拉坎德羅斯持有的龍之頭盔，以及尤拉什摩貢掌控的摩安德護手。至於戰力，我恐怕幫不上太多；不過我也曾冒險，知道如何不礙你們的手腳。」
zh-TW.zhentil.hooded_offer: 一名兜帽女子忽然現身。「跟我來，我能帶你們離開！你們已被困在這裡；我的主人能幫助你們。」
zh-TW.zhentil.fzoul_interrupts: 奇異的微光籠罩眾人，房間開始淡去。就在消失前一刻，一群祭司闖入房內，領頭的是弗佐爾・錢布瑞爾。他怒喝：「女人，你太過分了！」
zh-TW.zhentil.fzoul_retreats: 房間逐漸淡去；弗佐爾轉身衝出房間。
zh-TW.dexam.arrival: 你們被領過一條幽暗長廊，眼前赫然是眼魔德克薩姆！兜帽女子走向一群來回走動的披甲牛頭人；牠們立刻挺身肅立。
zh-TW.dexam.journal_30: 德克薩姆開口說話；你們將他的演說記入冒險手札第 30 條。
zh-TW.dexam.amulet_choice: 賢者迪姆斯沃特低聲說：「看祭壇上，那就是洛山達護符。」你們要怎麼做？
zh-TW.dexam.fzoul_journal_7: 你們還來不及行動，一名氣勢逼人的男子便率領士兵、祭司與法師衝入房內。他的發言已記入冒險手札第 7 條。
zh-TW.dexam.kills_fzoul: 德克薩姆咆哮：「那就去死吧，異端！」接著把弗佐爾轟成一堆灰燼。你們感到手臂上的枷印開始扭動。
zh-TW.dexam.kill_order: 「枷印既已消失，他們對我再無用處。殺了他們。」
zh-TW.dexam.amulet_rises: 德克薩姆轉向祭壇，準備離去。你們注意到護符正飄向他。
zh-TW.dexam.altar_melee: 德克薩姆離開時，他的部隊與弗佐爾殘存的人馬在你們四周陷入混戰。
zh-TW.dexam.final_reveal: 你們追上德克薩姆與他的爪牙；兜帽女子卸下偽裝——她竟是一名梅杜莎！
zh-TW.dexam.amulet_retrieved: 你們從德克薩姆殘破的遺骸中取回洛山達護符。
zh-TW.dexam.zhentil_attack: 散提爾堡的部隊向你們發動攻擊！
zh-TW.dexam.departure.olive: 奧莉芙・魯斯克特爾出現在門外。她說：「你們居然成功了，真令我意外。」
zh-TW.dexam.departure.dimswart: 「迪姆斯沃特，跟我來。暗影谷有個人想問你幾個問題。」奧莉芙與迪姆斯沃特隨即離去。
zh-TW.dexam.departure.gharri: 你們看見遠處有一名騎士。他忽然停下；片刻後，一聲彷彿「嘉莉——」的呼喊隨風傳來。
zh-TW.dexam.departure.riders: 騎士改變方向，策馬奔向一名身穿紫衣的女子。兩人相擁；女子躍上馬背，隨後一同遠去。
zh-TW.world.shadowdale.edge: 你們來到暗影谷外。要進城，還是繼續旅程？
zh-TW.journal.30.1: 手札條目 30（1/2）：德克薩姆說：「原來這就是弗佐爾藏著的小祕密。有意思。身為貝恩正統祭司的代表，我要把你們送到穆爾馬斯特，交給總督察長。」
zh-TW.journal.30.2: 手札條目 30（2/2）：「到了穆爾馬斯特，我會在實驗室研究這些枷印——只怕你們會非常不舒服。最後一道程序將奪走你們的性命；放心，痛苦頂多持續兩三個星期。等我揭開枷印的祕密，總督察長必會對他親愛的小弗佐爾大發雷霆，我們也終於能除掉這名異端和他珍愛的法師。」
zh-TW.journal.7.1: 手札條目 7（1/2）：「我是弗佐爾・錢布瑞爾，幽暗神殿的最高領主。你口中那些『寶貝法師』讓我得以追蹤你的手下。德克薩姆，你已越權。這些人身上有我的印記；到了適當時候，總督察長自然會知道我的功績。」
zh-TW.journal.7.2: 手札條目 7（2/2）：「真正為貝恩至高榮耀效力的人是我。貝恩賜予我們的力量，加上世俗法師的魔法，將在諸國建立貝恩霸權；這些受枷印控制的工具正是鞏固權力的核心，也能讓我駕馭並避開善良與守序者藏在魔法物品裡的陷阱。他們受我支配，而且只要我還活著，就永遠如此。」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.tyranthraxus-reveal: 枷印揭露出烈焰之主提朗瑟克斯；他命令你們前往迷斯卓諾與他會面。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.edge: 你們來到迷斯卓諾邊緣。要進入遺跡，還是繼續旅程？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.helm-north: 龍盔傳來感應：提朗瑟克斯就在北方。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.elf-spirit.greeting: 一名精靈幽魂現身，向你們致意。你們要怎麼做？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.elf-spirit.journal-25: 幽魂講述葬林的往事；你們將內容記入手札第 25 條，隨後它逐漸消失。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.elf-spirit.flee: 「原來你們是羊！那就成為我的食物吧。」幽魂逐漸消失。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-web: 一張散發黯淡紅光的巨網橫亙在通道上。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-web.brighter: 巨網發出的光變得更加明亮。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-web.stuck: 你們一踏入網中，立刻被牢牢黏住。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-web.hack: 你們揮砍巨網，紅光隨即消退，露出藏在其中的數道金屬套索。遠處傳來一陣咒罵，接著是急促離去的腳步聲。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-web.spiders: 幾隻巨蛛循著聲響前來查看。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-web.rakshasa: 幽魂大笑著現身，隨即消散，露出一名羅剎妖。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.grave.thri-kreen: 一名螳螂人正在挖掘墳墓；你們一靠近，它便轉身發動攻擊。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.grave.skeleton: 你們看見一具只挖出一部分的精靈骸骨，腕上的珠寶閃閃發光。要怎麼做？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.daemir.offer: 一個幽魂出現在你們面前。「我是黛米爾公主的幽魂。你們看來是善良的人，願意接受我的祝福嗎？」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.daemir.forgiveness-offer: 一個幽魂出現在你們面前。「我是黛米爾公主的幽魂。你們褻瀆了這片葬林——或許只是出於無知。現在跪下，便可接受我的寬恕。」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.daemir.forgiven: 「你們已獲得寬恕。」她的身影隨即消散。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.daemir.blessing: 「帶著我的祝福前行吧。」她的身影隨即消散。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.daemir.curse: 「你們太放肆了！只要身在迷斯卓諾，你們手中的武器就會自行扭轉。」她的身影隨即消散。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.phase-spider-wall: 你們一踏入此處，蜘蛛便從看似實心的牆壁中湧出。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.phase-spider-glowing: 發著幽光的蜘蛛在你們靠近時飛快爬來。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.phase-spider-bones: 蜘蛛在此堆起一堆骸骨，並守在周圍。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.bones.prompt: 你們要如何處置這些骸骨？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.thri-kreen.guards: 此處的守衛已準備迎戰。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.thri-kreen.bivouac: 螳螂人在此紮營，正準備據守到底。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.thri-kreen.reinforcements: 其他螳螂人聽見聲響，趕來增援。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.thri-kreen.stragglers: 又有幾名落後的螳螂人陸續趕到。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.thri-kreen.valuables: 你們收起了一些值錢物品。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.spider-mausoleum: 這座陵墓掛滿蛛網，而且網中有東西棲息。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.spider-funnel: 你們看見一道漏斗狀的蛛網。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.spider-warning: 一個低沉如耳語的聲音說：「蜘蛛會拚死守護牠們的巢穴。」你們還要繼續嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.spider-eggs: 蜘蛛猛然躍出；你們看見牠們身後有一些蛛卵。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.entry: 建築入口附近躺著一具被壓碎的螳螂人屍體；門口則立著一道幽靈般的身影。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.enter: 你們要進入這棟建築嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.welcome: 幽魂說：「歡迎，各位勇士。請進來覲見我們的王后。」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.armor: 兩副散發微弱魔力的盔甲分立階梯兩側。其中一副說：「王后願意接見你們。」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.armor-bows: 你們經過時，盔甲似乎向眾人躬身行禮。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.armor-crumbles: 盔甲隨即崩解成滿地鏽蝕碎片。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.greeting: 你們走近階梯時，一個聲音高喊：「王庭向諸位致意。」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.hostile: 你們走近階梯時，一個聲音高喊：「褻瀆者就該與褻瀆者交戰。」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.reward: 一名幽魂現身。「有諸位守護此地，我心甚慰。這些物品或許能助你們完成使命。」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.farewell: 「唉，我能留在此地的時間已經不多。願諸位一路平安。」她隨即消失。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.hostile-offer: 一名幽魂現身。「你們的同類已將這片葬林摧殘殆盡。若願意就此離去，便可拿走我們僅存的寶藏。答應嗎？」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.court.refusal: 「那就留下來與我們長眠吧！」高塔開始在你們四周崩塌，眾人連忙衝到外面。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-plume.gesture: 一名紅羽戰士做出表示友好的手勢。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-plume.journal: 紅羽戰士講述了他的遭遇；你們將內容記入手札第 33 條。接下來要怎麼做？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-plume.warning: 「跟我來。」一個低沉如耳語的聲音喊道：「小心，是陷阱！」紅羽戰士怒吼一聲，揮手使那聲音戛然而止。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-plume.refusal: 「那我自己來。」他穿過大門。忽然，一聲慘叫劃破寂靜。你們要前去查看嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-plume.spiders: 一座被挖開的墳墓中，發著幽光的蜘蛛蜂擁而出，守護牠們的卵。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.red-plume.reveal: 一座被挖開的墳墓中，發著幽光的蜘蛛蜂擁而出，守護牠們的卵。紅羽戰士退到一旁，朝你們放箭——他的外形隨即開始改變。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.clan-figure.greeting: 一道人影從陰影中現身。「向受枷印者致意！」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.clan-figure.journal: 那道人影飛快地說個不停；你們將內容記入手札第 56 條。「快走，快走，快、快！」說完，他便離去了。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.more-ruins: 你們正前往更深處的遺跡。要沿小徑前進，還是穿越樹林？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.greeting: 一名毛髮糾結、神色陰鬱的羅剎妖從轉角現身，向你們做出和平的手勢。你們要怎麼做？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.tale: 羅剎妖說：「我是提爾雪雅。」接著，他講述自己的遭遇；你們將內容記入手札第 5 條。你們願意跟他走嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.guards: 「那就跟我來。」入口有守衛把守。你們要發動攻擊嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.beyrha-arriv: 戰鬥聲引來另一名羅剎妖與他的隨從；他指責提爾雪雅劫掠自己的氏族。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.ultimatum: 貝爾哈說：「人類，把提爾雪雅的首級交給我，你們便能獲得寬恕；否則，今晚的主菜就是你們。」你們要攻擊誰？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.attack-beyrh: 「真是一群蠢貨，不過晚餐時我們會好好感謝你們。」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.tirsheya.name: 提爾雪雅
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.beyrha.name: 貝爾哈
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.storehouse.guards: 一些石像鬼與地獄犬守著這棟建築的入口。牠們擺開架勢，準備交戰。你們要逃走嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.storehouse.supplies: 這棟建築裡堆滿大量食物、衣物與各式小物件。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.storehouse.valuables: 這棟建築裡堆滿大量食物、衣物與各式小物件。仔細搜索後，你們終於找到了一些值錢物品。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.intro: 前方有一名男子在地獄犬群追趕下拚命奔逃，已近力竭。他踉蹌倒地。你們要上前救援嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.killed: 地獄犬撲上男子，將他撕成碎片，很快便完成了獵殺。你們要攻擊牠們嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.hounds-leave: 地獄犬離開了男子的殘骸。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.clue: 男子向你們道謝，低聲說：「我被抓住前……把東西藏好了……東北方……一棟廢墟……是給你們的報酬。」說完，他便停止了呼吸。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.remains: 地獄犬留下的殘骸幾乎已看不出人形。你們沒有找到任何值錢物品。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.fugitive.cache: 正如臨終男子所說，你們找到了那處秘密藏寶。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.nameless-warning: 無名者從陰影中悄然現身，說：「這樣直接逼近很危險，不過神殿就在北方。現在，快去辦正事吧！」說完便離開了。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.brush-decoy: 前方廣場長著一片茂密灌木。一名小孩——也可能是半身人——飛奔過來鑽了進去；一隻地獄犬正想跟著撲入。你們要上前救援嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.brush-rescue: 你們搶在地獄犬擠進灌木前趕到，將牠斬殺。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.brush-ambush: 一名羅剎妖從灌木中站了起來，說：「哎呀，多謝各位。如此善心，理當獲得回報。」牠一揮手，附近屋頂上的石像鬼便朝你們投擲石塊。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.brush-attack: 隨後，怪物紛紛躍下發動攻擊。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.brush-victim: 片刻後，地獄犬嘴裡叼著一團血肉，從灌木中鑽出，隨即小跑離去。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.brush-bloodstains: 灌木叢生，裡面堆滿瓦礫；幾片葉子上留有血跡。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-trap: 前方門口有兩隻石像鬼正在折磨一頭小動物，尚未發現你們。要發動攻擊嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-collapse: 你們迅速殺死了牠們。背後忽然傳來笑聲，隨即整座門廊崩塌，砸在隊伍身上。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-rakshasa: 你們仍被埋在瓦礫下時，一名羅剎妖走了過來。要裝死嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-surprise: 羅剎妖伸手抓來時，你們出其不意地發動攻擊。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.margoyle-retreat: 眼看崩塌未能置你們於死地，羅剎妖轉身便消失無蹤。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-margoyle: 一隻落單的石像鬼慌忙逃開，露出一座下水道柵口。牠似乎正想逃走。要放牠離開嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-escape: 牠鑽進下水道，轉眼便消失了。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-grate: 這裡有一座下水道柵口。你們要進去嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.sewer-warning: 腦海裡響起一個如夢似幻的聲音：「前方危機四伏，務必做好萬全準備！」你們仍要繼續嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.kitchen-arrival: 下水道盡頭通往一間昏暗廚房；一陣轟鳴與揚起的塵霧迫使你們鑽出地道。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.gambling-room: 這間房布置得極為奢華；幾名男性羅剎妖正在擲骰賭博，女性羅剎妖斜倚在軟墊上，石像鬼則聚精會神地觀看賭局。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.gambling-rise: 牠們這才發現你們，緩緩站起身來。你們要逃走嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.gambling-treasure: 你們收起了房內的值錢物品。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.inner.bedroom: 你們走進一間雅致的臥房，裡面擺著四柱床、掛毯與黃金飾件。要搜刮這個房間嗎？
zh-TW.myth-drannor.inner.office: 這個房間已被改作辦公室，四面牆上掛滿了邪神班恩的聖徽。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.inner.kitchen: 你們走進廚房；奴隸一見有人進來，紛紛鑽到桌下躲藏。他們對你們毫無威脅。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.rakshasa-residence: 一名羅剎妖在此過著奢華生活。
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.rakshasa-threat: 那名羅剎妖站起身，另有數名同族隨之現身。「膽敢打擾我這等地位者，便是在自尋死路。準備受死吧。」
zh-TW.myth-drannor.outer.rakshasa-parlay: 羅剎妖露出微笑。「你們的膽識令人耳目一新。」接著，他講述自己的故事；你們將內容記入手札第 57 條。
zh-TW.journal.25: 手札條目 25：我們這些迷斯卓諾的幽魂，歷經數百年後已日漸衰弱，如今只能在旁觀望。我們請求你們相助；作為回報，讓我告訴你們螳螂人的一項祕密力量。這棟建築裡有一張發出紅光的蛛網。站在網前說出「Krrkik」，再走進網中，你們便會獲得強大的力量。我曾見過許多螳螂人如此行事。
zh-TW.journal.33: 手札條目 33：「我是凱米爾，我的祖先世世代代都在迷斯卓諾生活，最後也長眠於此。近來，邪惡夢境不斷侵擾我；夢中，祖父的墓穴被那些骯髒的蜘蛛怪物占據，成了牠們的巢穴。若你們願意幫助我，讓他的靈魂重歸安寧，我便把這把由他親手打造的弓送給你們。」他展示一把工藝極其精美、散發強大魔力的長弓。
zh-TW.journal.56: 手札條目 56：那人說：「別問我的名字；名字不過是人們貼在自己無法理解之物上的標籤。我知道你們身上的枷印，也知道你們為了重獲自由所作的掙扎，因為在彷彿已十分久遠的往昔，我曾協助創造最初的枷印。你們最後一道枷印——烈焰之主提朗瑟克斯的枷印——是最危險的一道。不論你們是否明白，如今你們比以往任何時候都更接近永恆的奴役；提朗瑟克斯不必再與其他人分享對你們的控制權，他能以全部怒火阻止你們逃脫。你們唯一的希望，是攻其不備，在烈焰之主來得及喚起枷印力量前解決他。能與有足夠自信談成交易的人交談，實在令人愉快。我的族群將此地當作休憩數個凡人生命週期的場所；然而烈焰之主提朗瑟克斯奪走了我們的追隨者，還威脅我的族群。他力量強大，我們雖對他恨之入骨，卻無法直接攻打他的神殿。現在談談我們的交易。你們身上帶著烈焰之主的印記，但我聽說你們是他的敵人。當你們攻打他的神殿時，我們會運用力量奪回自己的追隨者；那或許能削弱他，讓你們取得勝利。」
zh-TW.journal.57: 手札條目 57：「能與有足夠自信談成交易的人交談，實在令人愉快。我的族群將此地當作休憩數個凡人生命週期的場所；然而烈焰之主提朗瑟克斯奪走了我們的追隨者，還威脅我的族群。他力量強大，我們雖對他恨之入骨，卻無法直接攻打他的神殿。現在談談我們的交易。你們身上帶著烈焰之主的印記，但我聽說你們是他的敵人。當你們攻打他的神殿時，我們會運用力量奪回自己的追隨者；那或許能削弱他，讓你們取得勝利。」
zh-TW.journal.5: 手札條目 5：「我們羅剎妖非常熱衷賭博。我先前手氣連番不順，幾乎輸光了所有財物。最近，我發現貝爾雪雅一直在賭局中作弊；然而沒有證據，氏族領主便不肯處置他。貝爾雪雅負責看守氏族倉庫，我知道裡面藏著能證明他作弊的證據。只要協助我闖進去，你們可從倉庫任取所需；我只要貝爾雪雅作弊的證據。」
